newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austrim sees 2nd half profit growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austrim sees 2nd half profit growth.

text.p: Investment group Austrim Ltd said on Thursday it was likely to achieve strong profit growth in the second half of the 1996/97 financial year.
The company, which is led by former BTR Plc chief executive Alan Jackson, achieved a 130 percent rise in first half net profit to A$5.47 million.

"Directors are confident that Austrim Group Ltd will continue to experience substantial earnings growth in the second half year ended 30 June 1997 from the further development of our group operations that have been implemented, together with the benefits of recent acquisitions and consolidation," it said.
Austrim said its first half profit rise was achieved from two businesses, AH Plant Hire and CDA Industries, both of which were acquired in the latest six months to December 31.
In the current half year, the company has said it planned to acquire the assets of the Calum textile business for A$76 million.
